preconditions.description: The number of students n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each of the n student lines contains exactly two integers: best friend index and sex.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(fi) <= n and int(fi) != i+1 for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each student i (1-based), their best friend index fi is an integer between 1 and n, and fi ≠ i.

preconditions.expression: all(si in {1, 2} for si in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each student's sex si is either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0].split() == [str(t), str(e)] and t == len(pairs) and e == sum(1 for a, b in pairs if (s[a-1] == 1 and s[b-1] == 2) or (s[a-1] == 2 and s[b-1] == 1))
postconditions.description: The first line of stdout contains two integers t (maximum number of valid pairs) and e (maximum number of boy-girl pairs among them). t equals the number of pairs printed, and e equals the count of boy-girl pairs in those t pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Each pair in the output consists of two valid student indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all((a != b) and (a == f[b-1] or b == f[a-1]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Each pair (a, b) in the output satisfies that a and b are distinct, and either a is b's best friend or b is a's best friend.

postconditions.expression: all(a not in used and b not in used for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()] for used in [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]] if a in used or b in used)
postconditions.description: No student appears in more than one pair in the output.

postconditions.expression: not any((a == f[b-1] and b == f[a-1]) and (a != b) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: No pair (a, b) in the output is a mutual best-friend pair (i.e., a's best friend is b and b's best friend is a) unless a == b (which is impossible by P3).

The output maximizes t (number of pairs) and, among all solutions with maximum t, maximizes e (number of boy-girl pairs). Here, max_possible_pairs is the maximum number of valid pairs possible under the constraints, and max_boy_girl_pairs is the maximum number of boy-girl pairs achievable among all solutions with max_possible_pairs.
